description:
What is Metrobi?

Metrobi is a Techstars-backed startup providing local courier services in 20 major metro areas across the U.S.

About the role

As an operations specialist, you will monitor ongoing delivery routes and communicate with delivery drivers and shippers over the phone and live chat.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in English
  • Being able to work based on the Eastern US time zone (EST)
  • Experience in logistics, courier operations, call center, customer support, or account management

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Analisar, planejar e executar atividades técnicas de gestão e produção de dados geoespaciais, conforme metodologias e padrões definidos pela empresa.

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em GIS;
  • Conhecimentos das soluções e produtos ESRI. O conhecimento de Survey 123, FieldMaps, Dashboards, Experience Builder é mandatório;
  • Compreensão referente a origem e conceitos básicos das tecnologias e metodologias para aquisição de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento de fontes de dados geográficos, como meios de aquisição (sensoriamento remoto, campo, aerofotogrametria) e órgãos nacionais (IBGE, INPE, CPRM) e internacionais produtores (USGS, NASA, FAO, etc);
  • Conhecimento sobre IDE’s e INDE;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de projeção (UTM, Lambert) e datums geográficos (WGS84, SIRGAS2000);
  • Conhecimento dos principais padrões de metadados existentes.
  • Desenvolvimento e automatização de processo utilizando Python

Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Conhecimento de CAD;
  • Conhecimento de softwares de PDI;
  • Conhecimento em Sensoriamento Remoto, Geodésia, Cartografia, Análise Espacial, SIG’s e GIS Web;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver atividades técnicas de gestão e produção de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos.
  • Interpretar documentos de especificação técnica de componentes e requisitos das soluções seja serviços ou produtos.
  • Prestar apoio no planejamento dos projetos na aquisição, tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos.
  • Analisar e gerar documentos de especificação técnica de componentes e requisitos das soluções seja serviços ou produtos.
  • Utilizar a edição de dados em geodatabase e criar modelos simples de geoprocessamento, criar, editar e explorar dados geográficos no PRO, criar layout simples de mapas e compartilhar mapas;
  • Utilizar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS, como ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos, aplicando os principais componentes e funcionalidades do sistema ArcGIS (Server, Mobile, Desktop, Online e extensões) e ter habilidade de identificar onde ela se aplica;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Realizar e aplicar modelagem de um geodatabase utilizando versionamento e elementos de rede e modelos complexos de geoprocessamento;
  • Aplicar a plataforma ArcGIS para realizar análise espaciais e ser capaz de automatizar processos;
  • Criar e aplicar elementos cartográficos dinâmicos e criar layout de mapas complexos;
  • Aplicar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS e ter habilidades avançadas para aplicar as ferramentas na visualização, criação, gerenciamento e análise de dados geográficos;
  • Aplicar o uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócios verticais de atuação da Imagem;
  • Criar e aplicar processo de gestão de dados na utilização do Production Mapping;
  • Propor a escala de trabalho adequada para a solução de diferentes problemas geográficos;
  • Resolver problemas de distorções e compreender características específicas de dados geográficos, cuja origem esteja relacionada com a fonte;
  • Ter domínio das funcionalidades do ArcGIS e propor melhorias na utilização das ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos e auxiliar a equipe;
  • Criar e propor melhorias nas soluções baseadas nos produtos ESRI;
  • Propor melhorias no uso das ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Domínio das principais extensões do ArcGIS e propor utilizações inovadoras na utilização das principais extensões;
  • Propor melhorias no uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócio/verticais de atuação da Imagem, melhorias na estrutura e modelos de dados inovadores para processos de negócios específicos, melhorias ofertas e processos de negócios, baseado na plataforma ArcGIS, soluções utilizando conceitos de IDE’s e INDE;
  • Criar e estruturar novas metodologias de execução de serviços de geoprocessamento, estimativas e controle de qualidade conforme as características específicas a serem executadas.

Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Senior Gen AI Engineer (Copilot)
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power AutomateSummary

We are seeking a Senior Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate to support and scale our organization’s use of AI-driven productivity tools. This role blends technical expertise in building and optimizing agents with the ability to support and guide non-technical users. The engineer will troubleshoot Copilot issues, review and refine agents, and ensure compliance with data loss prevention (DLP) and governance policies. Beyond day-to-day support, they’ll help strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) through documentation, lifecycle standards, and observability practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support & Troubleshooting: Own Copilot and Power Automate issue resolution, including connectors, permissions, and workflow errors.
  • Agent Review & Optimization: Refine agents for efficiency, scalability, and compliance with governance standards.
  • User Enablement: Guide employees in safely building and optimizing agents, explaining platform limits and data-handling best practices.
  • Architecture Awareness: Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns to improve design quality.
  • Governance & COE: Partner with data, security, and compliance teams on DLP alignment and contribute to Power Platform COE monitoring and lifecycle initiatives.
  • Documentation & Improvement: Create user guides, document patterns, and propose enhancements based on recurring issues.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core ).
  • Ability to design, troubleshoot, and optimize agent workflows and connectors.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP policies, and governance controls.
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical details for non-technical users.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of RAG, multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts.
  • Experience with observability, or cost monitoring.
  • Exposure to enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake).
  • Contribution to a Power Platform COE or similar governance effort.

We Offer:

  • 100% remote job.
  • Long term job.
  • Carreer path.

title: Analista de vendas
description:
Estamos contratando candidatos que residam nas cidades de VOTORANTIM e SOROCABA.

Empresa: E-commerce de artigos esportivos e utilidades domésticas

Cargo: Analista de vendas - Marketplaces

Benefícios:

  • Salário: R$ 2.500,00
  • Vale alimentação: R$ 400,00
  • Auxílio combustível: R$ 300,00
  • Comissão variável atrelada ao resultado de vendas "agressivo" nas plataformas administrativas.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento rápido conforme performance.

Buscamos um Gestor de vendas de Marketplace altamente organizado (a), dinâmico (a) e com perfil criativo para assumir a gestão completa das nossas lojas nas plataformas Tik Tok Shop, Temu e Shein.

Essa pessoa será responsável por todo o ciclo operacional e comercial, desde o cadastro de produtos até as campanhas, tráfego interno e criação de conteúdo em vídeo - inclusive aparecendo nos vídeos.

O que oferecemos:

  • Autonomia total na gestão das lojas;
  • Ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em um mercado em forte expansão;
  • Trabalhar diretamente com um time criativo e de alta performance;
  • Vaga de vendas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão das lojas;
  • Cadastrar e atualizar produtos nas plataformas ( preço, estoque, descrição e imagens );
  • Definição de estratégias de precificação e acompanhamento KPIs de margem e conversão;
  • Gerenciar o mix de produtos, promoções e campanhas por plataforma;
  • Analisar resultados e implementar otimizações contínuas;
  • Marketing e conteúdo;
  • Criar vídeos para Tik Tok Shop, Temu, Shein, e aparecer nos conteúdos demonstrando produtos e aumentando conversão;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de conteúdo alinhadas às tendências das plataformas;
  • Planejar e executar ações de tráfego interno ( boosts, criadores parceiros, promoções, etc. );
  • Relacionamento & Negociação;
  • Negociar campanhas e oportunidades com representantes das plataformas;
  • Manter relacionamento ativo para participação em promoções especiais ( lives, deals, vouchers, etc. );
  • Operações;
  • Acompanhar desempenho de pedidos, SLA, avaliação dos clientes e reputação da loja;
  • Gerenciar processos junto à equipe logística ( envios, devoluções e atendimento ).

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em Marketplaces ou E-commerce;
  • Conhecimento de Tik Tok Shop ( diferencial forte ), Temu e/ou Shein;
  • Habilidade com vídeos, comunicação e apresentação diante da camêra;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com habilidade para tomada rápida de decisão;
  • Noção de tráfego interno, tendências e estratégias de alto giro;
  • Disponibilidade para aparecer nos conteúdos em vídeo.

title: Gerente Geral
description:
Responsável pelo planejamento, organização, gerenciamento e controle de um Centro de Distribuição, envolvendo as áreas Comercial, Logística, Operações e Administrativa, atuando na orientação e acompanhamento de suas atividades e desempenho, garantindo o atingimento das metas estabelecidas, bem como contribuir para o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado, dentro dos prazos, legislação vigente, padrões de, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.

Principais responsabilidades:

• Assegurar a execução da estratégia comercial definida, garantindo a rentabilidade das operações comerciais, o desenvolvimento da área comercial e a ampliação do volume de negócios;

• Garantir em conjunto com a liderança logística e de transporte da unidade, as operações de Distribuição, mantendo o padrão de qualidade de armazenagem e de movimentação dos produtos, bem como a qualidade da entrega dos mesmos em todos os pontos de vendas;

• Garantir a exatidão dos estoques, produto acabado e ativo de giro sob sua responsabilidade, mediante execução das rotinas e monitoramento periódico dos inventários;

• Elaborar o orçamento anual das despesas do Centro de Distribuição, através de análise de históricos e previsões de crescimento, buscando atingir as metas traçadas para atingimento do lucro líquido e o aumento do market share, visando seu cumprimento em conformidade com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;

• Garantir a conferência dos caixas do CD bem como conferir o montante de valores enviados para área de controle assegurando a acuracidade financeira.;

• Conduzir a gestão de pessoas mantendo a equipe capacitada, habilitada e motivada para realização dos trabalhos.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

• Forte experiência em Gestão de Equipes de Vendas, Gestão Orçamentária, Administrativa e conhecimentos de rotinas Logísticas;

• Ensino Superior Completo;

• CNH B ativa;

• Experiência no segmento de bebidas.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-refeição;
  • Wellhub;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Veículo como ferramenta de trabalho.

title: Agile Facilitator
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience as a Scrum Master , acting as the main Agile facilitator for development teams.
  • Solid Business Analysis fundamentals , including requirements gathering, refinement, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Outstanding communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience facilitating local and remote Agile teams .
  • Proven coaching and mentoring capabilities.
  • Strong background promoting Agile mindset, values, and culture .
  • Knowledge of additional Agile frameworks or methods (e.g., Kanban, XP, Lean).
  • Deep experience with refinement, story splitting, estimation, velocity tracking, retrospectives, and other Agile techniques.
  • Good understanding of software development practices such as TDD, BDD, unit testing, test automation, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Advanced English is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary Scrum Master, ensuring Agile values, principles, and practices are consistently applied.
  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies and support effective team decision-making.
  • Coach and mentor Scrum teams to continuously improve delivery, collaboration, and predictability.
  • Partner with the Product Owner to support backlog refinement, prioritization, and clarity of requirements.
  • Apply Business Analysis skills to help translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories when needed.
  • Identify and remove impediments, dependencies, and delivery blockers.
  • Promote cross-team collaboration and eliminate siloed ways of working.
  • Enable data-driven continuous improvement through metrics, insights, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure goals, scope, and priorities are clearly understood across the team.
  • Support effective demos, reviews, and product/system testing activities.
  • Facilitate alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders when challenges arise.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.

As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company ( must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.

Why Join ?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Events Specialist (Mandarin/Chinese Speaker)
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Executivo de Contas Pleno
description:

Necessário para oportunidade:

  • Experiência com vendas de produtos e serviços de Tecnologia.

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

description:

LSG Sky Chefs is one of the world’s largest airline catering and hospitality providers, known for its outstanding reputation and dynamic approach in the industry. The job incumbent is responsible for supporting the business by drafting and reviewing contracts, as well as supporting the department in civil and corporate law matters, and other relevant topics to the company, providing risk assessment and guidance to mitigate risks in support of managerial decisions.

  • Advising internal clients on civil, corporate and regulatory law matters.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory updates, ensuring company’s legal compliance.
  • Advising on general topics in support of company’s interests.
  • Supporting company in licenses and permits proceedings.
  • Relationship with external law firms and internal departments
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external deadlines.
  • Support the company’s various business initiatives.
  • Foster best practices, collaboration and knowledge sharing across legal team.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Full qualified lawyer with good standing license from Brazilian bar association
  • At least 5 years of experience as an in-house lawyer
  • Proven experience in contractual law
  • Sounding knowledge of tax and corporate law highly desirable
  • Ability to work independently
  • High intercultural awareness
  • Advanced knowledge of Spanish

  • Full MS-Office package, including Excel.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases ( MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: HSE Coordinator (Goiânia / GO)
description:
MISSION

Lead the Safety department, ensuring the implementation of Coty’s global strategy at the site and full compliance with applicable Brazilian legal requirements. Act as an early and active partner in all matters that impact employee safety and the company’s reputation, guaranteeing adherence to the site’s Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Policy and Coty’s global HSE expectations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure full understanding and compliance with the Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Policy;
  • Comply with all company procedures and instructions, not only those related to occupational safety;
  • Advise local leaders on the human and financial resources needed to efficiently implement HSE policies, procedures, and programs;
  • Ensure the company is aware of upcoming legislation and its potential impact, while maintaining compliance with current laws and regulations;
  • Provide technical expertise to the site regarding HSE policies, procedures, and programs.
  • Develop and monitor objectives, targets, policies, procedures, and programs to meet legal requirements and continuously improve safety, environmental performance, and reporting systems;
  • Create and manage the site’s HSE Action Plan, ensuring proper follow-up and completion of all initiatives;
  • Participate in management meetings, as appropriate, to provide updates on HSE performance and related matters;
  • Ensure adequate and effective incident-reporting systems across all departments, including communication, escalation, notification, investigation, and corrective actions to prevent recurrence;
  • Collect and provide monthly accident and incident statistics, including lost-time cases and trend analyses, for senior management review;
  • Ensure the site maintains a fully compliant Safety Station according to Coty global standards, with proper training and resources to sustain the process;
  • Guarantee that sufficient and appropriate risk assessments are performed and that control measures proportional to risk levels are implemented throughout the site;
  • Prepare the annual HSE audit schedule and conduct audits to evaluate site performance against Coty’s Six Key HSE Management Elements;
  • Support the resolution of HSE issues as they arise;
  • Ensure all relevant health and safety records are maintained and readily available for inspections when required;
  • Interact with local HSE authorities—such as police, fire department, and health & safety inspectors—during visits/inspections and ensure implementation of their recommendations;
  • Ensure the Emergency Response Team is fully trained, operational, and prepared to act;
  • Ensure the Internal Accident and Harassment Prevention Committee (CIPA) operates autonomously and fulfills its responsibilities;
  • Ensure compliance with all municipal, state, and federal HSE regulations, as well as Coty’s corporate standards;
  • Ensure all third-party service providers comply with applicable health and safety legislation;
  • Schedule and participate in site audits and self-assessments;
  • Train and support key system owners in their respective HSE responsibilities.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related fields;
  • Postgraduate degree in Occupational Safety Engineering;
  • Advanced English proficiency (mandatory);
  • Extensive experience (minimum 5 years) managing high-risk operations, particularly in Occupational Safety roles;
  • Solid experience in people management;
  • Active participation in global HSE networks is a plus;
  • Strong knowledge of risk management, prevention, and control measures;
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook);
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong ability to document processes clearly;
  • Strong presentation skills and ability to communicate effectively across different organizational levels.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES (SOFT SKILLS)

  • Strong sense of ownership; actively present on the shop floor, identifying opportunities for improvement and team development;
  • Intellectual curiosity;
  • Agility, creativity, and innovation;
  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset, with fast execution;
  • Ability to go above and beyond, delivering high-impact results;
  • Capacity to build, develop, and engage teams quickly and effectively;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration spirit.

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!

Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.

Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for " SAP ABAP Odata" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil

SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .

Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.

Visit our website: siila.com.br

About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

Follow us: @siila.br

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Especialista em Infraops
description:
A Unimed BH

Somos a Unimed-BH, uma das melhores operadoras de planos de saúde do Brasil. Há mais de 50 anos, nosso propósito é cuidar da saúde, e esse cuidado se traduz em inovação contínua, qualidade com custo acessível, ética e sustentabilidade para oferecer o melhor serviço aos nossos mais de 1.500.000 de clientes.

O nosso compromisso é proporcionar um ambiente pautado pelo respeito, pelo acolhimento e pela valorização ao nosso time de mais de 10 mil profissionais, entre colaboradores administrativos, assistenciais e médicos cooperados.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, pessoas de todas as orientações sexuais e identidades de gênero, de diferentes raças e etnias, e idades, sem qualquer tipo de distinção.

Acreditamos que agilidade e simplicidade são a melhor forma de trabalhar e estamos sempre prontos para sugerir novas soluções para serviços e produtos, afinal, a inovação está no nosso DNA, o que nos leva a inspirar nossos colaboradores a atuarmos juntos, como um só time, com foco do cliente.

Para isso, oferecemos um ambiente propício ao desenvolvimento e benefícios atrativos de mercado. Esperamos você para seguirmos juntos cuidando da saúde!

É necessário que tenha:

  • Graduação completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em virtualização de servidores.
  • Experiência em ambientes VMware e/ou Nutanix.
  • Vivência em operações de data center, capacity planning, backup corporativo e troubleshooting avançado.
  • Experiência em gestão de fornecedores e contratos de infraestrutura crítica será considerada diferencial.
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação em Gestão de Infraestrutura de TI, Cloud Computing ou Projetos de Tecnologia.
  • Certificações desejáveis: VMware Certified Professional (VCP) / LPIC-3, MCSA, MCSE ou equivalentes / Certificações em soluções de backup (Commvault, NetBackup ou Veeam) serão consideradas diferenciais.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Definir padrões operacionais e arquitetônicos para ambientes VMware e Nutanix .
  • Planejar e coordenar a evolução tecnológica de hardware, hypervisores e sistemas correlatos.
  • Gerenciar indicadores de performance, utilização e capacidade (CPU, memória, storage e rede).
  • Supervisionar fornecedores e contratos de infraestrutura crítica , garantindo SLA, conformidade e governança técnica.
  • Validar requisitos técnicos de virtualização e alta disponibilidade em novos projetos.
  • Conduzir capacity planning e análises de tendência , propondo otimizações e balanceamentos de carga.
  • Participar de comitês técnicos e revisões de arquitetura , apoiando decisões sobre upgrades, migrações e padronizações.
  • Garantir a documentação, rastreabilidade e conformidade das mudanças e políticas operacionais.
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de backup corporativo (Commvault e NetBackup), assegurando retenção, consistência e restauração de dados em ambientes virtualizados.

Horário e Local de Trabalho:

  • De 8hs às 18hs (seg. à sex). Modelo Híbrido.
  • R: Inconfidentes,44, Funcionários

A Unimed-BH respeita a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas vagas. Sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência.

Identificou-se com os requisitos? Clique em "Candidatura Simplificada" e faça a sua inscrição! No portal de vagas da Unimed-BH, você encontra essa e outras oportunidades da Cooperativa. Acesse vagas.unimedbh.com.br e faça parte do nosso time.

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. title: Product Owner- AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.

Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Mall
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:

This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.

  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills

title: Gerente Comercial
description:
A GreenYellow é especializada em Eficiência Energética, Energia Solar, Comercialização e Gestão de Energia. De origem francesa, a empresa tem operações em oito países e possui um portfólio de Eficiência Energética com mais de 3 mil projetos implementados em todo o mundo, sendo mais de 1400 deles no Brasil, onde opera desde 2013.

Em energia solar, tem mais de 930 MWp globalmente e, no Brasil, possui mais de 70 usinas conectadas ou em implantação, somando 190 MWp de potência instalada. Atuando em toda a cadeia, a GreenYellow investe, desenvolve, constrói, e opera seus projetos no longo prazo.

Buscamos um(a) Gerente Comercial para liderar a equipe de vendas e expandir a presença da GreenYellow no mercado, além de ser responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais, construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e parceiros, e garantir o alcance das metas de vendas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégias Comerciais: Criar e implementar planos de vendas para cada um dos produtos de FV, BESS e EE/UaaS, baseados em análise de perfil de cliente e aplicação de cada solução, visando maior assertividade na geração de oportunidades qualificadas e aumento do Hit Ratio.
  • Identificação de Oportunidades : Pesquisar e identificar potenciais Vertical Markets, avaliando a atratividade e chance de fechamento dos nossos produtos.
  • Gestão de Equipe : Liderar e capacitar os Executivos Comerciais, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e assegurando que todos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa.
  • Criação, Acompanhamento e Entregas de Metas : Definir, acompanhar e avaliar as metas comerciais dos executivos da equipe via plataforma Senior, garantindo que todos estejam focados nas metas e motivados para atingi-las, e garantir o alcance das metas de vendas.
  • Relacionamento com Clientes estratégicos : Construir e manter relacionamentos duradouros com Key Accounts e oportunidades estratégicas, compreendendo suas necessidades e fornecendo soluções personalizadas que atendam às suas expectativas.
  • Gestão do pipeline : Definir a carteira de clientes dos Executivo Comerciais e acompanhar o desenvolvimento das oportunidades através do Salesforce.
  • Negociação e Fechamento de Contratos : Auxiliar os Executivos Comerciais na condução das negociações contratuais, assegurando maior agilidade nos estágios avançados das oportunidades (acima de 60%), assegurando condições favoráveis para a GreenYellow e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Solicitação de Aprovação de Investimentos : Conduzir a aprovação de investimentos com o COMEX e o Comitê de Investimentos, garantindo que todas as oportunidades estejam alinhadas com as expectativas da empresa.
  • Estruturação de Parcerias : Desenvolver e manter parcerias estratégicas com empresas de EPC, Senior Advisors e distribuidores de equipamentos, visando a ampliação do pipeline.
  • Trabalho com Marketing – geração de leads : Colaborar com a equipe de marketing na definição e execução de estratégias de prospecção outbound (campanhas de e-mails e MoveTruly), garantindo que as iniciativas de marketing estejam alinhadas com os objetivos comerciais.
  • Trabalho com Marketing – material comercial : Colaborar com a equipe de marketing na elaboração de materiais para suporte comercial, como apresentações para clientes e propostas comerciais.
  • Trabalho com Marketing – benchmarking : Colaborar com a equipe de marketing e inovação na análise de mercado para identificação de novos produtos que estejam alinhados com as necessidades do mercado.
  • Análise de Desempenho (KPIs) : Monitorar e analisar métricas de vendas e desempenho da equipe (KPIs), identificando oportunidades de melhoria e ajustando as estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Colaboração entre Áreas : Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de FV, BESS, EE, Jurídico e DAF para priorizar as demandas da equipe comercial e trazer agilidade em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento das oportunidades.
  • Gestão de Budget : Elaborar e gerenciar o orçamento da equipe comercial, garantindo o cumprimento do budget estabelecido. Aprovar despesas da equipe via Espresso e gerenciar aprovações de viagens pela plataforma Argo, garantindo conformidade com as políticas da empresa.
  • Participação em Eventos e Feiras : Representar a empresa em eventos do setor, feiras e conferências, promovendo a marca da GreenYellow e estabelecendo novos contatos comerciais.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada de no mínimo 5 anos na função.
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração e ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA será um diferencial.
  • Inglês fluente.

  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Wellhub
  • Programa de Saúde e Bem Estar Corporativo
  • Previdência Privada
  • PLR

Localidade:

Moema, próximo ao metrô Eucaliptos.

title: Strategy and Process Operation Expert
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Process Strategy Formulation and Optimization: Responsible for the overall design, strategic planning, and continuous optimization of key business processes, ensuring efficiency, standardization, and controllability, while aligning with company and business strategies.
  2. End-to-End Operations Management: Design and manage the entire process and its modules, from merchant information collection, review, onboarding to ongoing operational support, ensuring smooth business transitions.
  3. Multi-perspective Process Improvement: Continuously optimize workflows and execution standards based on the needs of merchants, frontline operations, BD sales, and other stakeholders, driving implementation and iterative upgrades.
  4. Data and Customer Insights: Identify process pain points and risks through customer feedback and data analysis, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to address issues at the source.
  5. Strategy-driven Improvement: Proactively identify process bottlenecks according to business development stages and objectives, formulate actionable optimization strategies, and drive project implementation.
  6. Standardization and Knowledge Accumulation: Establish and maintain process operation standards, create user-friendly operational guidelines and qualification criteria for frontline teams, ensuring efficient execution and compliance.
  7. Results Review and Iteration: Regularly summarize process and strategy optimization outcomes, develop standardized documentation and knowledge bases, and support business scalability.

Job Requirements

  1. Possess excellent process optimization and strategic thinking abilities, with clear logic and the capability to identify problems and propose practical solutions through research or data analysis.
  2. Strong cross-functional communication and project management skills, able to achieve complete closed-loop management from goal setting to execution.
  3. Highly result-oriented and goal-driven, with a spirit of exploration and self-motivation, able to maintain high performance under pressure.
  4. Familiar with service satisfaction survey and design methodologies, with experience in result analysis, evaluation, and continuous optimization.
  5. Good command of both Chinese and English in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, capable of supporting cross-border team collaboration.
  6. Certain product operation capabilities, able to propose product and process optimization solutions based on actual business needs to improve overall operational efficiency.

Job Highlights

  1. Deep involvement in team management and business process optimization,contributing to core business goals.
  2. Join an international team,collaborate with colleagues from 26 countries,and enhance global vision and cross-cultural abilities.
  3. Be part of an early-stage business, face diverse challenges and growth opportunities,and quickly advance personal capabilities.
